you can not (soft) delete anything 
you may edit it but not delete 
only administrators have a hard delete option 
and even that action gets logged

unlike myrestaurant which aspires to one day use named cloudflare tunnels 
this will forever live on quick tunnels 
fully aware that the url may change at any time or the site may be down for extended periods
so for this website 
the idea is to build a fully responsive mobile first project management tool 
this part requires logging in
so self organizing teams can collaborate on their projects 
the text boxes for the project management tool are "rich" in the sense you can paste text and screenshots from clipboards, 
add attachments up to a generous size limit for what we can store in postgresql

we will also have other features that do not require logging in
